name: video_generate
description: Generate video: one video per call, its fields at the root. Up to 30s, several shots fit one call via `multi_prompt` on a model that allows it; for longer pieces see `video_plan`. Pick a model with `slug` (copy it verbatim from `video_models_list`); omit `slug` for auto-select. People talking: pick a model whose `agentRecommendation.useFor` has `native_audio` and write each line in quotes after its speaker in the prompt; `video_speak` only when an exact voice is required or one voice must hold across clips. Image refs: use an asset URL or a creation `identifier`; never `webUrl`. To change an existing video use `video_modify`, not a video reference here. Limits: `video_models_list`. Returns queued creation identifiers. `creations_show` displays them in UI clients; `creations_wait` returns completed results.

audioUrl.description: Only for lipsync-only models whose catalog has audioConstraints without limit. Do not use for Seedance; use `references[].type="audio"` instead. Exclusive with `withSoundEffects`.

brandKitId.description: Only when model lists `brandKit`: `brand_kit_list` id; applies its palette, type and logo.

cameraMotion.description: Only when model lists cameraMotion values.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

url.description: Asset URL or a creation `identifier`; never `webUrl`. The whole keyframe may also be this string on its own.

looks.description: Only when model lists `looks`: one option `value` per group `key`, e.g. {"camera":"35mm-film"}.

noMusic.description: Only when model has noMusic.allowed. Keeps dialogue and sound effects but suppresses the background score. Use this instead of `withSoundEffects:false` when the user asks for audio without music.

prompt.description: Prompt. Check model maxLength. Exclusive with `multi_prompt`.

promptMode.description: Only when model has `multishot.showShotModeSelector`: `manual` renders the prompt as written; `auto` (default) lets the model direct the shot.

references.description: Allowed types/limits per model. For a Seedance audio reference, include `{type:"audio", url:"asset URL or creation identifier"}` here; this can coexist with `withSoundEffects:true`. Seedance 2.0 also needs a visual reference in this same `references[]` array (image/video/character/product/style) — a `keyframes.start` does NOT satisfy it, since start frames are mutually exclusive with references. Seedance 2.5 accepts audio-only references; check `audioReferences.requiresVisualReference` in `video_models_list`.

custom_model_id.description: Numeric `id` of a `library_list` asset. Only `character`, `product` and `style` (a `locations` asset is an `images_generate` reference, not a video one). Send it INSTEAD of `url`, with `name`; the server resolves the cover image. Omit `url` entirely.

images.description: Selected custom-model media IDs. Not for Kling.

type.description: Use `audio` for Seedance audio references (2.0 and 2.5): a guide for rhythm, mood and voice. The model composes its own soundtrack: it does not paste the audio in or clone the voice. For an exact voice, or one voice across clips, use `video_speak` (OmniHuman).

url.description: Asset URL or a creation `identifier`. Required for non-color/effect refs EXCEPT when `custom_model_id` is set (the server resolves the cover then); for a Seedance audio reference put the audio URL here with type `audio`. Never a library id — that is `custom_model_id`.

resolution.description: Required by some models; see catalog.

seed.description: Same seed + same settings reproduce a result on models that honor it (e.g. Seedance 1.x). Seedance 2.0 and 2.5 have no seed and do not use it. Omit for a random one. Read back as `seed` in `creations_get`.

slug.description: Model identifier copied verbatim from `video_models_list` (e.g. `bytedance-seedance-pro-2.0`); omit for auto-select. Only this field name is read — `model`/`modelSlug` are tolerated as aliases but prefer `slug`.
